description: This PHP class 'FormatWithJobTitle' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface and is responsible for formatting entity values into job title names by retrieving data through the 'JobTitleService'. It is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Maintenance Access Strategy for formatting values related to job titles.

classes.name: FormatWithJobTitle
classes.description: A class that retrieves and formats a job title name based on a given entity value, utilizing the JobTitleService.

methods.name: getJobTitleService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of JobTitleService.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Converts an entity value (presumably an ID) into a job title string by fetching the JobTitle and returning its name.
